l1_connect_account.title: Bring the sites nobody has inventoried into the migration plan
l1_connect_account.why: Virtual machines run at these sites, but the migration plan does not see them, so they will be found late, at the worst moment.
steps: List sites from the virtualisation console, the network and the asset register, branches included.
Run discovery at each site with a read-only account.
Confirm each site's machines, owners and size show in the plan.
l1_connect_account.success: Every site in scope has its machines inventoried with owners.
